blocks.text: Written by: IDr. Oren Loza Tarlac is entering an exciting period of growth, with new opportunities reshaping how people live, work and connect. At the center of this growth is Cresendo, Ayala Land’s 290-hectare estate envisioned as a mixed-use destination in Central Luzon. Its commercial, educational, industrial ,recreational and future residential spaces by Avida create a new hub for business, lifestyle and community life in Tarlac. Traditions that bring people together Tarlac’s strong cultural influences shape its food and celebrations. The annual Kanlahi Festival showcases this diversity through performances, products, and activities. Cresendo builds on this identity, bringing culture and contemporary […]...
